Criminal Application [Aba] No. 51 Of 2026
 Deepak S/o Vitthalprasad Dube And Another
 Versus
 State Of Mah., Thru. P.S.O., P.S., Mankapur (City), Nagpur
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, Court's or Judge'
appearances, Court's Orders or directions and
Registrar's order
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Mr. A. N. Shinde, Advocate for the applicants.
Mr. Nitin S. Autkar, A.P.P. for the non-applicant/State.
Coram : M. W. Chandwani, J.
Date : February 04, 2026.
1.  Heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicants.

2. The applicants are apprehending arrest in connection with Crime No. 447/2025 registered with Police Station, Mankapur (City), Nagpur for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The applicant is the President of Netaji Housing Society.

Applicant no.1 through his power of attorney Rashmi Joshi (applicant no.2) purchased the property by way of a registered sale deed from Shankar Shrawan Jadhav through Power of Attorney Satyendra Chauhan
The remaining land was agreed to be sold by Shankar Jadhav after executing the possession receipt.
4. The contention is that, now the daughter of Shankar Jadhav is disputing the said transaction and filed an FIR against the applicants alleging cheating.
2 49 aba51.26.odt
5. Issue notice to the non-applicant/State, returnable on 25.02.2026.
6. Learned A.P.P. waives service of notice on behalf of the non-applicant/State.
7. Considering the submissions and the contents of the FIR, perusal of case diary is necessary which is not available at present.
In view of the above, a case is made out for grant of interim protection to the applicants.

Insofar as attendance to the police station is concerned, the learned counsel for the applicants seeks to rely on the medical documents annexed with the application in respect of applicant no.1,
who suffered a Brain Stroke.
Therefore, attendance of applicant no.1 to the concerned police station will be considered at the time of final disposal of this application.

9. In the event of arrest of applicant no.1 - Deepak S/o vitthalprasad Dube and applicant no.2 - Mrs.
Rashmi W/o Anurag Joshi in connection with Crime No. 447/2025 with Police Station, Mankapur (City), Nagpur for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, they be released on bail on furnishing a PR bond of Rs.25,000/- each (Rupees Twenty Five thousand only)
with one solvent surety each in the like amount.
10. Applicant no.2 shall attend the concerned Police Station on every Friday and Tuesday between 10.00 am and 12.00 pm for three weeks and cooperate with the investigation.
The applicants shall not indulge in pressurizing the prosecution witnesses or tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
